// rbacPlugin: const
declare const rbacPlugin: (options: RbacPluginOptions) => {
    id: "rbac";
    endpoints: {
        getRbacSnapshot: better_auth.StrictEndpoint<"/rbac/snapshot", {
            method: "GET";
            use: better_auth.Middleware<better_auth.MiddlewareOptions, (inputContext: better_auth.MiddlewareInputContext<better_auth.MiddlewareOptions>) => Promise<{
                session: {
                    session: Record<string, any> & {
                        id: string;

                        expiresAt: Date;
                        token: string;
                        ipAddress?: string | null | undefined;
                        userAgent?: string | null | undefined;
                    };
                    user: Record<string, any> & {
                        id: string;
                        createdAt: Date;
                        updatedAt: Date;
                        email: string;
                        emailVerified: boolean;
                        name: string;
                        image?: string | null | undefined;
                    };
                };
            }>>[];
        }, RbacSnapshot>;
    };
    init: () => {
        options: {
            databaseHooks: {
                user: {
                    create: {
                        after: (user: {
                            id: string;
                        }) => Promise<void>;
                    };
                    delete: {
                        after: (user: {
                            id: string;
                        }) => Promise<void>;
                    };
                };

        };
    };
};
